question: On Agreeing to the Resolution, as Amended — Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7148) the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7147) the Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2026; and for other purposes (H RES 1014)
bill_title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7148) making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 7147) making further consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and for other purposes; and for other purposes.
plain_language: Adopting this rule sets the terms for House debate on H.R. 7148 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026) and H.R. 7147. A Yea adopts the rule; a Nay rejects it. Rule votes usually split along party lines.
